outcome: Number of packed cells transfused post-IR
Additional surgical interventions needed after IR
IR-related complications (puncture site hematoma or bleeding, necrosis, metabolic complications)
cohort: Fifty-four consecutive patients who underwent peripartum interventional radiology (IR) for prevention or treatment of postpartum haemorrhage at a tertiary academic centre between 01/01/2010 and 31/12/2020.
finding: Interventional radiology for the prevention and treatment of postpartum haemorrhage was highly successful in reducing the need for transfusions and additional surgical interventions, and was associated with mostly minor complications.
